thought.text: The frontend hit a Bus error — likely a native module (SWC) issue. Let me get details:

reasoning_content:
The frontend is throwing a "Bus error (core dumped)" — this is a classic sign that in-container native modules (swc) compiled for the host CPU/architecture are incompatible with the container's glibc. The devcontainer base is typescript-node:20-bookworm, and the host is ubuntu 22.04 jammy (also glibc 2.35) — but the host's node_modules was installed on the host with the host's node 20.20.2 (nodesource). Actually, a Bus error (SIGBUS) usually indicates a memory mapping issue, but it can also happen with native swc binaries when there's a glibc mismatch. The devcontainer image is bookworm (glibc 2.36), the host is jammy (glibc 2.35) — binaries built on 2.35 should work on 2.36. Hmm.

No wait, let me actually verify: the node_modules were installed with the host's Node 20.20.2. Inside the container, node is v20.x from mcr's image (v20.20.2 was shown). A Bus error from @swc/core's native .node binary… let me get more details. I'll check the full frontend log.
